item.title: Issue #2819 created
item.description:
A step too far: notes

@michaelhkay A little summary of the pending comments from #2734:

  1. “If S1 is neither a sequence of XNodes nor a sequence of JNodes” → “If any item in S1 is not a GNode”
  2. descendant-or-self::* → descendant-or-self::gnode()
  3. Add def="dt-non-trivial" for <nt def="IfExpr">IfExpr</nt> and subsequent expressions
  4. Add try/catch/finally
  5. Add otherwise
  6. Add absolute path expressions? like E1/(/a)
  7. …and three comments from @Arithmeticus, https://github.com/qt4cg/qtspecs/pull/2734#pullrequestreview-4640744699
